liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Reviewer describes the stand-alone performance as sweet; Reviewer notes the song features a good Jerry jam [13][20][22]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes the performance of this song as truly nasty; Reviewer calls this particular version of the song absolutely incredible [19][20]
- **Playing In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer notes the song is filled with Fender Rhodes sounds; Reviewer finds this performance incredible and listens to it all the way through [13][21]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the extended jam sequence leading into Wharf Rat [12]
- **Nobody's Jam** (1 review): Reviewer identifies this jam as the highlight of the show [18]

## The recordings

- **gd74-06-16.sbd.cribbs.26452.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 232 min; rated 4.22/5 by 18 [1]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.fink.15781.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 232 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [2]
- **gd74-06-16.sbd.fink.17701.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 232 min; rated 4.47/5 by 47 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the recording for its great Wall of Sound quality; Reviewer finds the sound quality spotty throughout the recording; Reviewer notes the first two minutes are dominated by drums [14][16][17][18][19]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.bryan.207.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 231 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Uploader notes a splice at 4:04 and serious mix problems prior [5]
- **gd1974-06-16.143135.sbd.partial.gastwirt.sirmick.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 14 songs; 124 min [10]. Said about its sound: Small dropouts were repaired in the Eyes Of The World section [10]

## Around the show

- Ned Lagin's contributions make the Playing In The Band performance distinctive [12]
- Reviewer complains that Ned Lagin's electronic noise ruins a few songs [16]
- Reviewer claims the following Louisville show eclipses this Des Moines performance [14]
- Reviewer states the band did not reach another peak until May 1977 [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-06-16.sbd.cribbs.26452.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Set 1 lineage is MSR to C to DAT to CD; Sets 2 and 3 lineage is MSC to DAT to CD [1]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.fink.15781.shnf**: transferred by Alan Fink; source: S : MR > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN [2]. Also: New SHNs were created by Alan J Fink MKW [2]
- **gd74-06-16.sbd.fink.17701.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer acquired one of their first tapes of this show in 1977 [21]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.bryan.207.shnf**: transferred by Michael Bryan; source: SBDMR>DAT>CD>EAC>SHN [5]. Also: Sets 2 and 3 derive from unknown generation reel source DAE [5]
- **gd1974-06-16.143135.sbd.partial.gastwirt.sirmick.miller.flac1644**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: SBD > MR > Dat (44.1k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt [10]. Also: Sources were picked up from DATs provided by Rich [10]
